method: Visual inspection of actual raster captures through 73 contact sheets, one sheet per image view. No OCR. Phone and short viewports retain the full viewport. Desktop integration sheets crop to the measured surface with a 24-pixel margin when narrower than 1000 pixels; desktop reader sheets crop horizontally around the dialog. Every direct-viewer frame was also inspected at its full original viewport.
observations: The real bulk and single creation entries show the native template picker inside the viewport. The last choices are reachable through its internal scroll in the short view.

Archive headers, round navigation and close/export controls remain visible in both languages and themes. Exact legacy rounds show their recorded verdict and commit, including missing findings and missing history.
Expanded archive decks retain reading and fold navigation without transcript, host, account, prompt-answer or delivery mutation controls.

Current and completed stages, a fresh review after a fix, a spent review budget, the answered question receipt, verdict evidence, task history and the conversion entry remain readable through the recorded scroll positions.
Independent review groups remain attached to the subject in the taskless Viewer card and the shared board deck. Full Viewer frames show no separate reviewer cards.

Long content uses the existing scroll containers; these captures represent their recorded scroll positions. Automated range, viewport, hit-test, focus, shortcut and input measurements are retained in the linked records.
